newsitems.title: Watch the Hades Orchestral Concert, Live from London!
newsitems.author: kid_zomb
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43315153/aad983f32d27d927f5cc178938d011eb28363d3c.png[/img] On June 27 at London's Royal Festival Hall, our composer and audio director Darren Korb will be joined by his fellow [b]Hades[/b] vocalists and conductor Austin Wintory in a one-time-only orchestral concert, [b][url=https://gamemusic.net/events/ballads-of-the-underworld-featuring-music-from-hades-and-hades-2/]Ballads of the Underworld[/url][/b]! If you've enjoyed the music of [b]Hades[/b] and [b]Hades II[/b], or any of our games, you do not want to miss this once-in-a-lifetime performance.

newsitems.title: As well as adding all of Hades 1 into Hades 2, the Zagreus' Journey mod now brings new boons, story beats, and more
newsitems.contents: When Mark wrote about Zagreus' Journey back in December, the mod was already well on its way to completing its main goal: putting all of the original Hades into Hades 2. In the months since, modder Nikkel Mollenhauer has gone way beyond that target. The mod has officially hit 1.0 and it's added new story beats, boons, and a tonne of new cosmetics to pretty up your lair.

newsitems.title: Hades: It's the Five-Year Anniversary!
newsitems.author: kid_zomb
newsitems.contents:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35685771/af1733d629a1d5f905691d5a93425394b1b4f622.png[/img] Five years have flown by since the v1.0 launch of [i][b]Hades[/b][/i], our studio's fourth game! It went on to earn more than 70 Game of the Year awards, exceeding our wildest expectations. We're now just days away from launching [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1145350/view/512967793587520056?l=english]our first-ever sequel[/url] that we've been working on ever since, and wanted to commemorate the anniversary of the original.
